defer kispang-farm adult 4
defer kalika-village adult 3
defer kakani-farm adult 3

</plan>
COST: 577

Notes:
- Car1 can only reach Jwalamukhi (its other roads are damaged), so it makes one round trip for the 4 elderly there.
- Kispang, Kalika and Kakani are cut off by damaged roads, and Benighat, Dupcheshwar and Panchakanya form an isolated group. Those 15 people are deferred.
- Car2 does two tours from Trishuli: the first collects 2 adults at Syaphru and 1 elderly and 1 injured at Thakre (31 min); the second collects 3 elderly at Belkot and 1 injured at Bidur (70 min).
- Driving totals 137 min (car1 36, car2 101). Deferral penalties total 440 (4 children 240, 4 adults 80, 3 adults 60, 3 adults 60).
